structuralFinding.rootCause: Governance is pinned from authored Ticket graph neighbors; the resolver tracks actual file mutations separately and never resolves governing scope from those impacts. Completion and reuse fingerprint only the authored governance.
structuralFinding.requiredCorrection: One owned, graph-grounded applicability contract must connect authored intent, real preview/apply impacts, producing context, independent verification and proof reuse, without a second registry or another compensating guard.

fixedFindings.rootCause: Rule preview mistook a persisted draft layer for effective active authority.
fixedFindings.fix: Resolve active inherited authority when the prior layer is not active.

fixedFindings.rootCause: The small-file fallback threshold silently determined the completeness of an authored whole-file review.
fixedFindings.fix: Provide complete whole-file source under the existing total context budget; avoid redundant exact-source reads for whole-file targets.

fixedFindings.rootCause: Failed required exact-source acquisition was silently swallowed, allowing partial evidence.
fixedFindings.fix: Propagate an identified source failure and its cause.

fixedFindings.rootCause: Rule membership was conflated with mandatory blocking severity; expected checks were omitted or called unknown.
fixedFindings.fix: Deliver expected checks to the default verifier, retain their nonblocking deviations, recognize all known Rule IDs, and invalidate receipts when applicable expected normative content changes.
